title: GTA6 Sleuths Are Divided Over Whether Key West Is in the Game
description: Following the extended gameplay preview for Grand Theft Auto 6, fans are currently divided and debating whether the famous Florida locale Key West is included.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Community Divided Over Key West Inclusion

Grand Theft Auto fans are widely known for their love of speculation and deep information sleuthing. This behavior has certainly not slowed down since Rockstar released the extended gameplay preview for Grand Theft Auto 6. Following this latest promotional material, the community's current major fixation is centered around a very specific geographic question: whether or not Key West will actually be featured in the game.

### Community Speculation Following the Preview

Ever since the release of the extended gameplay preview, players have been examining every frame to understand the scale and scope of the game's map. As the title is set in a fictionalized version of Florida, fans have naturally turned their attention to the state's most famous landmarks and regions.

Key West, known worldwide for its distinct island culture, tropical environment, and iconic coastal aesthetics, has become a major point of interest. Players looking at the sun-soaked visuals and coastal environments shown in the preview have begun debating whether this famous Florida locale has been adapted into the game's world.

### Fans Are Torn on the Rumor

Despite the intense discussions, the community remains divided on the matter, and opinions are split into distinct camps:

* **Optimistic Fans:** Believing that Rockstar aims to capture the essence of Florida, this group argues that Key West or a heavily inspired equivalent must be included to complete the southernmost portion of the game's map.
* **Cautious Observers:** Others point out that Rockstar often condenses, redesigns, or entirely invents locations for narrative and gameplay pacing, meaning real-world accuracy is never guaranteed.

It is important to note that all discussions surrounding the presence of Key West are currently unconfirmed community speculations, as Rockstar Games has not made any official announcements regarding specific regional inclusions beyond the broader setting.

### Editor's Take

The dedication of the GTA community to dissecting every piece of media is unmatched. While the debate over Key West remains purely speculative for now, it highlights the immense excitement surrounding the game's world design. We will have to wait for official updates to see how much of Florida's geography makes the final cut.
